name: How long does a custom basement renovation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a custom basement renovation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a custom basement renovation depends on the project's scale and complexity. A small-scale remodel might take a few weeks, while a comprehensive design involving structural changes, new bathrooms, or custom features could extend to several months. Our project planning includes a detailed schedule, and we work efficiently to minimize disruption while maintaining high quality standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: A custom basement renovation's duration varies from weeks to several months, depending on the project's size and complexity.
